dedupe_keys.name: bilan previsionnel electrique 2019 offre de production

description: Bilan prévisionnel électrique 2019 - Offre de production is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données détaille l'offre de production en France (installations de production et capacités d'effacements) pour le cas de base du bilan prévisionnel 2019, de 2020 à 2025. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Production. Its keywords are Prospective, Parc. The portal shows 2021-10-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
